To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
shelf life of functional buffalo meat products can be extended by 10 days by incorporating MPP and AP at 0.50% level.
the shelf life of buffalo meat steaks can be extended by 20 days by using MPP and AP as functional ingredients.
MPP and AP at 0.50% level in FRBMS could extend the shelf life of the products for 20 days under refrigerated storage.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a new product, i.e. functional restructured buffalo steaks, which is fortified with mousambipeel powder or amla powder.
the development of functional restructured meat products from buffalo meat.
the development of functional restructured beef products using buffalo meat.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the shelf life of FRBMS was not extended by the incorporation of MPP and AP at 0.50% level in the product.

incorporation of MPP and AP at 0.25% and 0.5%, respectively in FRBMS did not bring about adverse effect on the quality attributes during refrigerated storage and hence can be used as functional ingredients in meat products.
the shelf life of FRBMS can be extended up to 20 days at refrigerated storage when MPP or AP are incorporated in the product formulation.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the shelf life of the functional restructured buffalo steaks can be extended up to 20 days by incorporating MPP and AP at 0.50% level.
MPP and AP can be incorporated in FRBMS without any adverse effect on its shelf life.
the shelf life of restructured buffalo meat products could be extended by incorporating MPP and AP at 0.25% (w/w) level in pre-standardized buffalo meat formulations.
The main takeaway from our work is that
buffalo meat can be fortified with natural antioxidants to enhance the shelf life of meat products.
the shelf life of FRBMS fortified with MPP and AP can be extended up to 20 days without any significant change in the physico-chemical and microbiological properties at refrigerated temperature.
the functional restructured buffalo steaks can be fortified with MPP and AP and stored for a period of 20 days without affecting its physico-chemical and microbiological quality.
